description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/central_D_lon_periodic — 2nd-order centered zonal derivative with explicit periodic wrap on the rank-3 latlon3d grid. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLON=8, NLAT=5, NLEV=4 bound at the import edge), inlines the central_D_lon_interior body-reference template (esm-spec 9.7.3), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: D(u,lon) replaced by the rule's rank-3 three-region makearray (centered interior over [2,7] x [1,5] x [1,4]; the two full-rank periodic-wrap slabs at i=1 and i=8), fired at the default priority, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the free name dlon_deg surviving. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
